outcome: Clashing reveals the top card of the library, which then either stays on top or moves to the bottom.
Clashing with an opponent makes both the player and that opponent reveal their top card and choose top or bottom.
note: In a two-player game choosing the opponent is trivial; the observable part is that the opponent clashes too.

outcome: The player who revealed the strictly highest mana value wins the clash; ties and lower values do not win.
